name: apple-design
title_zh: 拿 HIG 当尺子量你界面的每一处细节
tagline_zh: 给 iOS/macOS/Flutter/React Native 的界面做体检，专挑和苹果人机交互指南打架的地方。
tagline_en: Audits iOS/macOS/Flutter/RN/Tauri UIs against Apple HIG—catches 1pt misalignments, contrast misses, and every.
desc_en: Cross-platform UI/UX design reviewer grounded in Apple Human Interface Guidelines principles. Use this skill to audit, review, critique, or improve any UI/UX design for mobile apps (iOS, Flutter, React Native) or desktop apps (macOS, Tauri, Electron). Triggers when the user mentions: design review, UI audit, HIG compliance, improving app design, design feedback, accessibility audit, or any request
why_zh: 不是泛泛而谈的审美建议，而是逐条对照 HIG 官方条款给出可执行修改，连 spacing、层级。
why_en: Not vague taste—checks each element against specific HIG clauses, quantifies spacing, hierarchy, and touch targets down to.
limit_zh: 只审视觉与交互规范，不碰动效性能、后端逻辑；需要你提供界面截图或代码片段，否则无从下手。
limit_en: Only visual/interaction HIG compliance, not motion performance or backend logic. Needs screenshots or code snippets to work. Limited use for Android.
title_en: UI reviewer that measures your design against Apple HIG
